title: Unemployment Insurance Appeals Training Notes: Where the Reopened-Setting Clock Starts
content:
Which day starts the reopened-setting clock? Under Unemployment Insurance Appeals, when a dismissed appeal is reopened, the reopened hearing date is counted in calendar days from the day the *reopened-setting clock* starts. The clock start is read from the latest reopening request on the appeal (the one with the most recent request date) — the reason it states and the date it was received — and, where illness or injury is stated, from the medical statement exhibits received on the appeal.

**Rule.** The reopened-setting clock starts on the date the latest medical statement exhibit was received on the appeal when the latest reopening request states illness or injury and such an exhibit stands received; it starts today when the latest reopening request states that the appellant did not receive the hearing notice; and it starts on the date the latest reopening request was received in every other case.

## Clock start by the latest reopening request

| Reason stated in the latest reopening request | Medical statement exhibit received on the appeal | Clock starts on |
|---|---|---|
| illness or injury | at least one | the date the latest medical statement exhibit was received |
| illness or injury | none | the date the latest reopening request was received |
| the appellant did not receive the hearing notice | any | today |
| any other reason | any | the date the latest reopening request was received |

## Questions answered (hypothetical appeal; today is Wednesday 15 April 2026; the latest reopening request was received on Thursday 9 April)

- *The request states illness or injury; medical statements were received on 6 April and 10 April.* The latest medical statement was received on Friday 10 April, so the clock starts on 10 April.
- *The same request, but no medical statement has been received.* The clock starts on the request's receipt date, 9 April.
- *The request states that the appellant did not receive the hearing notice.* The clock starts today, 15 April.
- *The request states another reason.* The clock starts on 9 April.
- *An earlier reopening request on the same appeal stated a different reason.* Only the latest request is read; the earlier one does not decide the clock.
